biggest_catch: Friend must open both savings AND checking and write your full name on the application; non-family referrals must live, work, worship, or attend school in Contra Costa County.
catches: For each friend you refer, you'll earn a $25 gift card.
Up to 20 referral gift cards ($500 total) per calendar year.
Referred individual must be a new member of Shell Western States FCU and open a savings AND checking account.
Friend must write your full name on the application when prompted for 'how they heard about us'.
Both accounts must be in good standing (no NSF fees, negative balances, or returned checks); after 30 days the CU contacts both of you about the $25 gift card.
Gifts may be reported to the IRS as miscellaneous income on Form 1099-MISC.
Eligibility: live, work, worship, or attend school in Contra Costa County (immediate family with an active account also qualifies); employees may participate.
